quests.instruction: What item do we wear over everything else when it is very cold outside?
quests.hint: It is thicker and warmer than a jacket!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Coats are made of thick materials to keep you warm in the winter.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our hands when it is cold outside?
quests.hint: They go on your hands!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Gloves have separate spots for each of your fingers.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet under our shoes?
quests.hint: They go on your feet before your shoes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks absorb sweat and keep your feet from getting blisters.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our legs on a hot summer day?
quests.hint: They cover your legs, but only a little bit!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts are perfect for summer because they keep your legs cool.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to stay warm and cozy indoors?
quests.hint: It is soft, warm, and often knitted!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Sweaters are usually knitted from wool or cotton yarn.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our head on a sunny day?
quests.hint: It sits right on top of your head!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Hats protect your head and face from the hot sun.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that has short sleeves and pulls over our head?
quests.hint: It has short sleeves!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: T-shirts get their name because they are shaped like a capital letter 'T'.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our shirt to protect us from chilly wind?
quests.hint: You put this on over your shirt!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: A jacket is usually lighter than a heavy winter coat.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to bed every night before we go to sleep?
quests.hint: You wear these to bed!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Pajamas are loose, comfortable clothes meant specifically for sleeping.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet when we walk outside?
quests.hint: They go on your feet before you go outside!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Shoes protect your feet from sharp rocks and hot pavement.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that hangs down from our waist?
quests.hint: It hangs down from your waist!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Skirts are garments that hang from the waist and leave the legs open.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that covers our body in one long piece?
quests.hint: It is one piece that covers your whole body!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: A dress is a single piece of clothing that covers the top and hangs over the legs.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on the top part of our body?
quests.hint: It covers your chest, tummy, and back!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Shirts usually have collars, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet that reach up past our ankles?
quests.hint: They cover more of your leg than regular shoes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Boots cover the foot and usually extend up the ankle or leg.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear around our neck to keep cozy and warm?
quests.hint: It wraps around your neck!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: A scarf is wrapped around the neck to keep the winter chill away.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to keep each finger warm and toasty?
quests.hint: Each finger gets its very own little space.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: They help protect your hands from frostbite in the snow.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to keep our toes warm and cozy?
quests.hint: You wear two, one for each foot.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: The longest sock ever knitted was over 3,000 feet long!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our legs to keep them warm?
quests.hint: They cover both of your legs, all the way down!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants cover each leg separately all the way down to the ankle.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is knitted from soft, warm yarn?
quests.hint: You pull this over your head.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: They are designed to be pulled over your head instead of buttoned.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is thicker and warmer than a light jacket?
quests.hint: You wear this over all your other clothes.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: The first coats were made of animal hides thousands of years ago.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to keep the warm sun out of our eyes?
quests.hint: It covers your hair.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: There are thousands of different styles of hats around the world.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is soft, loose, and comfortable for sleeping?
quests.hint: They are soft and loose, not tight.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: The word 'pajama' comes from a Persian word meaning 'leg garment'.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on a warm day when we do not need long sleeves?
quests.hint: It simply pulls over your head, no buttons needed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: They were originally designed as undershirts for soldiers.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that stops above our knees to keep our legs cool?
quests.hint: They stop above your knees.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: They became very popular for sports in the early 20th century.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear when we go outside on a cool morning?
quests.hint: It has long sleeves and often a zipper.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Windbreaker jackets are made of special nylon to block the wind.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground?
quests.hint: You wear socks underneath these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: The oldest known leather shoe is over 5,500 years old.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear to a birthday party to look extra special?
quests.hint: It often twirls when you spin.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Historically, dresses were the standard everyday clothing for most women.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of pants, with a shirt on top?
quests.hint: It is worn with a top, not by itself.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: In some cultures, traditional skirts are worn by both men and women.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear when we splash through puddles or trudge through snow?
quests.hint: They are perfect for muddy puddles.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Cowboy boots have a special heel to stop the foot from slipping through a stirrup.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that we wrap around and around before going outside?
quests.hint: It can be long and dangly or short and cozy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Some scarves are made of incredibly soft silk.
